sourceFacts: One shared frame: horizontal temperature axis t points right, vertical length axis l points up; both axes have short unnumbered tails past their intersection. The origin is printed 0.
Two horizontal dashed guides run from the length axis to the straight line: lower l_0 at its starting point and upper l at the later intersection.
Two vertical dashed guides run from those same line points to the temperature axis: t_0 below the starting point and t below the later intersection.
Exactly one positive-slope straight solid line starts at (t_0,l_0), passes through the later (t,l) guide intersection and continues beyond that intersection to the unlabelled finite upper-right end.
The line does not start at the origin or extend back to the length axis; no dots, numeric calibration, lattice, negative ticks, additional lines, formula annotations or atom scene are printed.
modernRegularization: Clean deterministic strokes and readable mathematical labels; source subscripts retained.
Drawing-space coordinates only preserve ordering, collinearity and guide intersections; they are not source temperatures, lengths or measured slope.
No added points, endpoints, numerical ticks, fitted material coefficient, equation or atom scene.
